subject: Vendrix - performance verification cadence & evidence exchange
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@vendrix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendrix - performance verification cadence & evidence exchange

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're starting the hands-on onboarding and want to lock the performance verification plan so we can align PMs and SREs on our side. A few items we'd like Redwood to validate during the onboarding benchmark window: 

- Sustained throughput target: 120 requests/sec for our baseline traffic shape (mix attached).
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 420ms, tail (99.9) < 700ms for the production-like payloads.
- Cold-start/scale-up behavior: recovery to baseline within 90s when scaling from zero to target concurrency.
- Error budget: <0.5% 5xx during a 30-minute steady-state run.

We attached our workload profile (vendrix_workload_profile.json) and a small sample of traffic (vendrix-traffic-samples.csv). Can you confirm Redwood's recommended test window, preferred run shapes (steady state + burst), and what artifacts you'll deliver after each run (raw logs, token-level latency histogram, KV cache hit-rate, runbook timestamped evidence)?

Also please include a short mutual action plan (MAP) with dates for: environment prep, dry-run, official run, and result review. We're aiming to complete verification the week of July 6 if that's possible.

Attachment: vendrix_workload_profile.json (application/json)
Attachment: vendrix-traffic-samples.csv (text/csv)

Thanks,

Alice Kim
Head of Platform Reliability
Vendrix, Inc.
alice.kim@vendrix.com
(415) 555-0147
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@vendrix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendrix - performance verification cadence & evidence exchange

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear targets and artifacts. We can run to the matrix you sent. High-level proposal below, happy to tweak before we formalize the MAP in the shared Drive folder.

Planned verification cadence (proposal):
1) Environment prep & smoke validation (internal Redwood + Vendrix env check) — target July 1–2
2) Dry-run (30m steady-state + 3 short bursts) — target July 5 (collect raw token logs + histogram)
3) Official verification run(s): two 30-minute steady-state runs + a 10-minute burst stress test — target July 7
4) Results review & artifact handoff (redwood-runbook-v1.pdf + raw logs + latency histograms + KV cache metrics) — target July 8 (30-minute readout)

Acceptance thresholds we'll validate against (confirming your numbers):
- Throughput: 120 rps sustained (±5% allowed for short bursts)
- Latency: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 420ms, p99.9 < 700ms
- Error rate: <0.5% 5xx during steady-state
- Recovery: ramp to baseline within 90s on scale-up

Artifacts we'll deliver after each official run:
- Timestamped event log (JSONL) with request id, latency, status code
- Token-level latency histogram (CSV + PNG)
- KV cache hit/miss rates and prefix-cache snapshots
- Short narrative run summary (1 page) with deviations and mitigations

Pre-reqs we need from you:
- API endpoint & test API key scoped to staging (we prefer an IP allowlist)
- Confirmation of payload sizes and any required auth header shapes
- A primary ops contact to join the dry-run and official window (ops@vendrix.com is fine)

I've created a draft MAP in the shared Drive (link below) and attached the runbook stub. If the July 7 official window works, we'll schedule a 30m pre-check on July 6 to confirm infra and keys.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3VendrixOnboard
Handoff artifacts (example): redwood-runbook-v1.pdf
Attachment: redwood-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

I'll loop in Ben to coordinate any Dedicated capacity reservations if we need reserved slots.

Best,

Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
(650) 555-0220
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@vendrix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ops@vendrix.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendrix - performance verification cadence & evidence exchange

Thanks Irene — that schedule looks good. ops@vendrix.com will be the primary point for the pre-check and official window. Also adding security@vendrix.com so they can confirm any data-handling constraints for the logs you plan to export.

Couple of clarifications:
- Can Redwood share the token-level latency histogram as both a CSV (raw) and a small PNG? Our security team prefers the PNG for initial review and the CSV behind an access control link.
- On the KV cache snapshots: we just need a high-level hit/miss ratio and a sample of prefixes, not the full cache content.

If all good we'll accept the July 7 run and join the July 6 pre-check at 9:30am PT. I'll place a calendar hold once you confirm the time.

Alice
